test_title: PYST 31: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some apples are fruits.

All fruits are vegetables.

No vegetable is healthy.

**Conclusions:**

I- No apple is healthy.

II- No healthy is vegetable.

III- Some vegetables are apples.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Only conclusions II and III follow.

solution:
Statements:
Some apples are fruits.
All fruits are vegetables.
No vegetable is healthy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3c266c84ec41f55797f50eca8cc64736684786fa956f650ed79362ca7568532f.png] 

Conclusions:
I- No apple is healthy → False (No direct relationship given between apple and healthy, so it may be possible but not defined)
II- No healthy is vegetable → True (It is given that no vegetable is healthy, so no healthy is vegetable)
III- Some vegetables are apples → True (It is given that some apples are fruits and all fruits are vegetables, so some vegetables are apples)

Hence, **"Only conclusions II and III follow"**.
